verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer SDK like Stagehand, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The server-side caching and Browserbase session recording and observability items describe data collection features, not a way to disable tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
